# EduDelphi

> > EduDelphi offers comprehensive online certification programs in accounting, finance, and compliance to help professionals advance their careers globally.

EduDelphi is a leading provider of professional certification training with programs in accounting (CMA, CPA, ACCA), finance (CFA, FRM, IFRS), auditing (CIA, CFE), and compliance (ACAMS, AMLS, CCM, KYCS). The platform delivers live classes, expert instruction, and exam preparation through online learning.

## Key Topics

- CMA (Certified Management Accountant)
- CPA (Certified Public Accountant)
- ACCA (Association of Chartered Certified Accountants)
- CIA (Certified Internal Auditor)
- CFA (Chartered Financial Analyst)
- FRM (Financial Risk Manager)
- IFRS (International Financial Reporting Standards)
- ACAMS (Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist)
- CFE (Certified Fraud Examiner)
- Compliance Training
- Online Certification
- Professional Credentials
- Exam Preparation
- Career Advancement
- Live Classes

## Accounting Certifications

- [Online CMA Certification](https://edudelphi.com/online-cma-certification): CMA certification course details, syllabus, eligibility requirements
- [Online CPA Training Course](https://edudelphi.com/online-cpa-training): US CPA training course with expert instructors and pass guarantee
- [Online ACCA Course](https://edudelphi.com/acca-course-online): ACCA online course with live classes, Kaplan materials, mock exams
- [Financial & Managerial Accounting Associate (FMAA)](https://edudelphi.com/financial-managerial-accounting-associate-fmaa-certification): IMA FMAA certification for accounting and finance fundamentals
- [Accounting Certification Courses](https://edudelphi.com/accounting-certifications): Accounting certifications including CMA US, CPA US, ACCA training

## Finance & Investment Certifications

- [CFA Course](https://edudelphi.com/chartered-financial-analyst-cfa-course): CFA certification course covering Levels I, II, III exam prep
- [FRM Course](https://edudelphi.com/live-frm-course-online): FRM certification course by GARP for financial risk management
- [IFRS Diploma Course](https://edudelphi.com/online-diploma-ifrs-acca-course): IFRS DipIFR diploma course for global accounting standards
- [Online Finance Courses](https://edudelphi.com/finance-certification): Finance courses including FRM, CFA, DipIFR certifications

## Auditing & Fraud Prevention

- [CIA Certification](https://edudelphi.com/online-cia-certification): CIA certification course with syllabus and eligibility requirements
- [Online CFE Course](https://edudelphi.com/online-certified-fraud-examiner): CFE certification course for fraud examination professionals
- [Auditing & Investigations Course](https://edudelphi.com/auditing-investigations): Auditing course covering CIA, CFE, fraud detection, compliance

## Compliance & Anti-Money Laundering

- [ACAMS Certification](https://edudelphi.com/certified-anti-money-laundering-specialist-acams): ACAMS CAMS certification training for AML compliance professionals
- [AML Compliance Courses](https://edudelphi.com/aml-compliance-courses): AML compliance training covering regulations and financial crime
- [AMLS Certification](https://edudelphi.com/amls-anti-money-laundering-specialist): GCI AMLS certification for anti-money laundering specialists
- [CCM Certification](https://edudelphi.com/ccm-certified-compliance-manager-certification): GCI CCM certification for compliance and AML roles
- [KYCS Certification](https://edudelphi.com/kycs-know-your-customer-specialist): GCI KYCS certification for KYC/AML compliance professionals

## Strategic Management & Analysis

- [Certified in Strategy and Competitive Analysis (CSCA)](https://edudelphi.com/certified-in-strategy-and-competitive-analysis-csca): IMA CSCA certification for strategy and competitive analysis
